title: From the Vault: Relics: card flavor text

entities.name: Ivory Tower
entities.description: A place whose inhabitants value scholarship above all else and reward those who sacrifice power for knowledge.

entities.name: Arcum Dagsson
entities.description: A Soldevi machinist who advises knowing foes' strengths as well as their weaknesses.

entities.name: Soldevi
entities.description: The people or culture to which the machinist Arcum Dagsson belongs.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: An artifact that, according to Braids, offers what you want rather than what you need.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A dementia summoner who comments on the Mirari.

entities.name: Sol Ring
entities.description: A ring of purest gold that traps light from a distant star, made by a lost artificer's art.

entities.name: Zur the Enchanter
entities.description: An enchanter who will go to any length for eternal life.

entities.name: Zuran Orb
entities.description: An orb associated with Zur the Enchanter.
